"ad9db02aa317443c98164b4f26d583dc"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"（三）强奸后迫使卖淫的；"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"ab0daccc-ab5f-40e0-888c-11c2fa1433e8","nodeId":"f8788d8ec4924f7e94f61d36762ed790"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"（四）造成被强迫卖淫的人重伤、死亡或者其他严重后果的。"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"75f47636-1ab8-4352-9fe2-d14d58f438d1","nodeId":"8065d588c9364f3c9161b1d4d0fcd97e"}},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"4dbe2284-53c7-483c-99e1-c6ce925b1c48","nodeId":"bb88ceb081d0447dadfebaa6037f313b"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"三、引诱、容留、介绍他人卖淫的，处五年以下有期徒刑或者拘役，并处五千元以下罚金；情节严重的，处五年以上有期徒刑，并处一万元以下罚金；情节较轻的，依照治安管理处罚条例第三十条的规定处罚。"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"84b3dbe7-858d-43ba-897c-6b0c8cdf5d56","nodeId":"4419475428d1414f915f891b8d766034"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"引诱不满十四岁的幼女卖淫的，依照本决定第二条关于强迫不满十四岁的幼女卖淫的规定处罚。"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"b145c3b3-bf96-4768-9b55-1fbae25c1308","nodeId":"fff10e68453c441caad91d789e20f281"}},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"9284de50-1b8e-49d2-9b3e-834710fb942f","nodeId":"c5d8ed73dfa14b41a31f48162d535d24"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"四、卖淫、嫖娼的，依照治安管理处罚条例第三十条的规定处罚。"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"701b90ba-7d63-4ae2-a9f6-6a29d8a0f0d8","nodeId":"33968573427e4d988dc736e57462acc8"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"对卖淫、嫖娼的，可以由公安机关会同有关部门强制集中进行法律、道德教育和生产劳动，使之改掉恶习。期限为六个月至二年。具体办法由国务院规定。"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"efb9b0a9-9b79-45d6-ad08-edf14ca3ae49","nodeId":"0d3331644a5b4250b1d2fc92fc6ea484"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"因卖淫、嫖娼被公安机关处理后又卖淫、嫖娼的，实行劳动教养，并由公安机关处五千元以下罚款。"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"edf5ff99-ceae-4ebe-b3f5-e29858782ff2","nodeId":"454344c40ce74a5f8ca6e9f31f328920"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"对卖淫、嫖娼的，一律强制进行性病检查。对患有性病的，进行强制治疗。"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"01b3f848-b3e9-4688-aafa-5568cff0a090","nodeId":"cc0010953c6f487d87a45eb618eaf0a9"}},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"fd289e4e-37f7-465f-bbed-15c690827afa","nodeId":"fb3a7310f9a7464688841ce48780226f"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"五、明知自己患有梅毒、淋病等严重性病卖淫、嫖娼的，处五年以下有期徒刑、拘役或者管制，并处五千元以下罚金。"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"252ab42f-0f79-4724-957c-b08487cb3212","nodeId":"8060b1583e6b421c97149434541aacee"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"嫖宿不满十四岁的幼女的，依照刑法关于强奸罪的规定处罚。"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"536b884a-5f99-4928-843d-3948a516f2a3","nodeId":"7c3b81ebac394eb49a36d4f626ee212e"}},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"5a2f47a3-ebe3-4290-9467-854173b2ddac","nodeId":"915f5c27fccc4c45813ba6ee2c18b883"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"六、旅馆业、饮食服务业、文化娱乐业、出租汽车业等单位的人员，利用本单位的条件，组织、强迫、引诱、容留、介绍他人卖淫的，依照本决定第一条、第二条、第三条的规定处罚。"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"a4c06702-14f5-46ec-9e60-d1875c259157","nodeId":"8036a93cd51d455d81217492591bad04"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"前款所列单位的主要负责人，有前款规定的行为的，从重处罚。"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"41ae6deb-ed49-4838-9ca4-0a73a2e3488c","nodeId":"ed1a00faa3ea493da00aa64f4cdf5bc1"}},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"e199fc1f-3154-43b0-9acb-7851bc66f7e8","nodeId":"ffb905c1b82c484aa23284ee53d70422"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"七、旅馆业、饮食服务业、文化娱乐业、出租汽车业等单位，对发生在本单位的卖淫、嫖娼活动，放任不管、不采取措施制止的，由公安机关处一万元以上十万元以下罚款，并可以责令其限期整顿、停业整顿，经整顿仍不改正的，由工商行政主管部门吊销营业执照；对直接负责的主管人员和其他直接责任人员，由本单位或者上级主管部门予以行政处分，由公安机关处一千元以下罚款。"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"21e096b0-0a61-47fa-a70e-2c57c3b780bb","nodeId":"cd10f6af6e54487992578aa20abfb189"}},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"0c0aef2d-8f83-4b6
